TEXT:
[FI] Now then, compared to a few moments ago, hasn't 
it gotten a lot better?

[FI] Next up, time to comfort the person most affected 
by all this...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, Makabe-kun.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] What is it, Senpai... I'm useless at this point, please 
leave me alone...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=17]You know that Galge art book you wanted? I'll bring it over one day. 
[/font_size]
[FI] It's Kirino's but whatever.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=25]R-Really!? The one with all the sexy illust--[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Keep it down! Just get back to whatever you were 
doing. I'll tell you more later.

[FI] Sena's looking this way. I'm trying to clear my 
"Sexual Harassment Senpai" title here.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Got it! I'll do my best!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] ...Kousaka-senpai, what were you two talking about...? 
Makabe's acting weirdly energetic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's a promise between men. Right, Makabe?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, that's right.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ?

[FI] Well, we're men, this sorta thing will always get us 
excited.

[FI] Makabe plays a significant role in the game's 
creation, if he's always curled up being depressed, 
we would all be in a tight spot.

[FI] Still... to borrow that art book from Kirino, I wonder 
what should I say...

[FI] And so, the chaotic game development team 
settled down to something more orderly... But, this 
doesn't guarantee completion before the deadline.

[FI] With all the commotion, we've fallen further behind 
schedule. The days passed with impending danger, 
the deadline ruthlessly approaches.
[FI] Then, I unexpectedly witnessed such a scene.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, Kousaka-senpai, good work today. What's the 
matter? Why are you here so late?
[FI] That's what I should be saying.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I realized I forgotten something after getting home, 
so I came back to get it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What about you? Weren't you heading home?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Well, given our progress so far, I don't think we'll 
make it in time for the cultural festival.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I thought I could wrap up some of the work I'm 
able to do alone, so I came back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I see... The lights were still on in the club room, so I 
thought the president or the others would be here 
playing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Too bad, it was Sena-chan.

[FI] Her hands still moving, she continued to work as we 
talked.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I've been doing this for a few days, and I think our 
progress has been getting better.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Huh? You mean it's not just today, you've done this 
plenty of times already?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Yes. If Onii-chan finds me he goes, "Where are you 
going so late at night?" and makes a fuss, so I 
sneak out...

[FI] That means no one else in the club knows about 
this either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Must be hard, working all by yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah... Without Gokou next to me, I get crazy with 
my imagination and the pictures get a bit too wild, 
bad stuff like that happen.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] But without everyone else around, my delusions 
don't go wild as often, so it's about the same.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...You're amazing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Huh? I-I am?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah. To make something you want, you're even 
willing to put in the extra time and effort. That's 
amazing.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I-It's not something that impressive. My delusions 
are just so powerful that I have to put them into 
form! That's all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] As a fujoshi, I guess it's my nature, my work, and 
my pride.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I see... If it helps motivate you this much to create 
works, maybe being rotten isn't so bad.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] R-Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah. I don't hate it. If it helps make progress, isn't 
it fine to be more honest about your interests?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's best to do what you truly want.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...Yeah.

[FI] This was the first time Sena's hands stopped 
moving.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Um... Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I'm... glad you're like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Like what? Just so we're clear, I don't understand 
your interest one bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Um... not that... You approve of my interest, or rather...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] You're even fine with me carrying on with my 
interests...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I can't really put it into words properly, but... It's fun 
when I'm with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-Is that right?

[FI] After saying that, she shifted her glance downward. 
It looked like she was getting a bit red.

[FI] It's just the two of us here... I mean, don't we have 
a good mood going on here...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-Is there anything I can help with?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] O-Of course, there's a mountain of things you can 
do. Don't tell me you plan on staying as well, 
Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...There's no way I can just head back and abandon 
my junior.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...You're really nice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Not really, I'm normal.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Is that kindness what caught Onii-chan's heart?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That again?

[FI] I might be saying that, but that made me a bit 
happy.

[FI] Isn't this how we usually act when we're together? 
It's easier to work like this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Actually, I've brought over some stuff. Here, take 
whatever you like.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ah, that pudding looks great. Is it really okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Don't worry about it! It's just some stuff that I 
bought from the convenience store on my way 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I'll gratefully accept it then!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] This is great...! It's totally delicious! You have a great 
eye for this stuff!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] For real? It was just in the recommended area, so 
I just bought some.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] You mean you haven't had any? This won't do at all, 
you ought to have some! This flavor will surely 
become a precious memory in your youth!

[FI] That's just something from the convenience store 
though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, it's fine. If it's good, then do enjoy it yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] No! I want you to eat it as well so we can agree 
and both say "This is delicious!"

[FI] ...Hey now, you've completely entered little sister 
mode.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Okay, open your mouth! Come on!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Okay, okay.

[FI] I opened my mouth in anticipation, doing what I 
was told. Sena puts the spoon in my lips. The sweet 
flavor spreads throughout...

[FI] At this moment, I realized it. Whoa, isn't this reaction 
really similar to what couples experience?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] It's good, right? Didn't I tell you it's good? Right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-yeah... It really is great.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Eh... Senpai, your reaction is too muted! Are you 
trying to act cool like a hard-boiled senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] S-Shut up! We're getting back to work after this, 
alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I got it already~.

[FI] Honestly, I'm not sure about the flavor. But, there's 
one thing I do know.

[FI] This is fun. Hanging out and doing something 
together.

[FI] I decided, I'll drop by with another bunch of 
"supplies" next time. That is of course, if Sena is 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, at any rate, keep up the good work. Here, just 
treat these as supplies from a comrade-in-arms, you 
can have it all.

[FI] I handed the juice and snacks I bought at the 
convenience store over and decided to leave the 
club room.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Can I really have these?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah it's fine, I'll see you here tomorrow then, 
okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Yes! I'll be waiting.

[FI] Phew. Feels like it just gotten more awkward, so I 
ended up escaping.

[FI] I'm weak to pressure from these lovey-dovey 
situations... Since I'm not used to them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, putting that aside, I've done all I can.

[FI] I contacted all the other members and gave them 
some words of encouragement.

[FI] I've been a bit soft in managing this project. I'd 
better look over and revise the schedule when I 
get back.

[FI] All I can do now is provide support for what she 
does.

[FI] After parting with Sena, I headed home alone... 
Then I remembered her words from earlier.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Um... not that... You approve of my interest, or rather...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] You're even fine with me carrying on with my 
interests...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I can't really put it into words properly, but... It's fun 
when I'm with you.
[FI] ...It's fun being with me, huh...

[FI] Clearly I was embarrassed, so I couldn't find out 
more but, was that... a confession?

[FI] I don't think it was on that level. Still, I was 
confident that we had a good thing going on...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Perhaps with just one more attempt, I might end 
up groping some breasts...
